profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Wix.com
profile.geoLocationName: White Plains, New York, United States
profile.summary: Software engineer specializing in frontend development. Have a proven track record of delivering new products and features on time. Highly collaborative and able to clearly communicate technical concepts and issues to stakeholders. Experienced with working on diverse, decentralized teams.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Developer for Partners team, empowering freelancers and agencies to build and sell on the Wix platform. 
• Contributed to Wix Marketplace, allowing partners to offer their services and custom-made templates for sale. 
• Built frontends and designed and implemented backend-for-frontend services to aggregate data across internal  microservices, covering all elements of the service pipeline including: offers, invoicing, earnings tracking, client management, and project handoff.
 • Developed AI agent skills enabling Wix chatbots to recommend partner services to users based on their conversation.
positions.insights: Skills: Front-End Development · Online Marketplace · Test Automation · Next.js · Software Infrastructure · TypeScript

positions.title: Full Stack Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · Remote
positions.description:
• Worked throughout the stack to deliver SaaS products that generated tax and compliance reports. 
• Delivered multiple features across a new multi-tenant tax provision SaaS product and a transfer
pricing product, including an Amazon Lex chatbot implementation and entity completion status
spanning UI, APIs, database, and permissions across 4 stacks.
• Migrated a legacy product’s Angular frontend to React, aligning coding standards across company
repositories.
• Architected and stood up a service from scratch using AWS Lambda, SQS, and Terraform that allowed users to roll relevant data into subsequent years’ reports.
• Collaborated with management to find compromises, allowing us to deliver features efficiently and on time.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · API Development · Amazon Web Services (AWS) · SQL · React.js · Agile Methodologies

positions.title: Assistant
positions.description:

• Painting, wallpapering, cleaning and preparation.
